cards.text: Nadia's got a ledger out — a real one, not the back of an envelope — and she's already three columns into it by the time you sit down.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "I've started writing it down. Who's got what, where. Not for anyone else — for me, so I stop finding out we've lost something a week after everyone else does."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Feels like something to be careful with, that."
Nobody quite picks that up. Nadia's already turning the page, asking who's carrying what, and the room goes with her — relieved, mostly, to have somewhere to look.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "Right. Sensible split, nothing heroic. Someone finds us fresh ground, someone keeps an eye on the place that's most exposed, everyone chips in on stock. I'll square you up for a start."

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "You can't fight and you can't calm anyone down, you can just get hit slightly slower than you used to. Make some Blast. Make a Shield. And do one of the Prank — not because I think you'll need it, because I think you won't reach for it, and you should have the option sat there anyway."
